mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate is held constant for two consecutive months above 5.0%, market expectations for future rate cuts increase, lowering real discount rates and boosting equity present-value pricing, which drives positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
regime_hint: FOMC holds or cuts rates after a restrictive stance
failure_condition: Over a 60-day window, SPX 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from the pre-trigger mean (t-test p > 0.05), or the 2-month FEDFUNDS stay above 5.0% is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp monthly increase in CPIAUCSL by more than 0.3% followed by a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS by at least 0.25% within the next three months is associated with a short-term monetary easing that accelerates equity valuation growth, producing positive 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases >0.3% in month t, then FEDFUNDS decreases >=0.25% in months t+1 and t+2
regime_hint: Inflation surprise followed by rate-cut anticipation
failure_condition: Across 10 such trigger events, less than 40% produce positive 20-day SPX returns (quantile rank < median).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly rise in PAYEMS of at least 2% for three consecutive months signals strengthening labor market conditions, which reduces the cost of capital via wage growth and supports higher corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases >=2% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: In regimes with strong wage growth, 60-day forward returns are not statistically higher than during comparable pre-tightening periods (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp monthly decline in INDPRO by more than 1.5% after a prior month of industrial production exceeding 100.0 triggers expectations of supply-side softness, compressing equity risk premia and producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > 100.0 in month t, then INDPRO decreases > -1.5% in month t+1
failure_condition: During confirmed supply shocks, less than 30% of predicted negative signals result in negative 20-day SPX returns (IC < -0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST rises by at least 10% in a single month compared to the prior month, it indicates accelerating consumer demand, which elevates earnings growth forecasts and supports higher equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Across 15 such events, the 5-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in UNRATE below 4.5% for two consecutive months, in the absence of inflation acceleration, suggests a shift toward a lower-forget rate environment that reduces discounting of future cash flows, resulting in positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4.5% for two consecutive months and CPIAUCSL < 0.2% month-over-month
failure_condition: During confirmed normalization, 20-day forward returns do not exceed the average of the prior 12 months (median IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When PAYEMS falls by more than 1.0% for two consecutive months amid a rising UNRATE, it signals weakening labor demand and rising wage-price pressures, which increases perceived business costs and lowers equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS decreases >1.0% for two consecutive months and UNRATE increases
regime_hint: Labor market softening with wage growth
failure_condition: In 10 such episodes, SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (IC > 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: A double-dip in RSAFS below 350 million dollars in two consecutive months, following a prior month above 370 million, forecasts near-term supply disruptions and reduces equity risk appetite, producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 370.0 in month t, then RSAFS < 350.0 in months t+1 and t+2
failure_condition: During confirmed disruptions, less than 20% of predicted negative signals result in negative 20-day SPX returns (IC > 0.10).
